name: Frost thermostat in after-heating disconnected or short-circuited
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D3 is flashing
action: Check that the water after-heating element and its connections have been insulated correctly. Reset the alarm once the error has been rectified.

name: Risk of frost in after-heating element
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D3 is flashing
action: Check that the water after-heating element and its connections have been insulated correctly. Reset the alarm once the error has been rectified.

name: Activating fire input
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D1 + D2 are flashing
action: If there has been no fire, check the connection to the fire thermostat. If it is working, contact service.

name: Fire
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D1 + D2 are flashing
action: Extinguish the fire and reset the alarm.

name: Frost in after-heating
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D3 + D4 are flashing
action: Check that the water after-heating element and its connections have been insulated correctly. Reset the alarm once the error has been rectified.

name: The room temperature is too low
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D3 + D4 are flashing
action: When the room temperature falls below the set value (default set at 10 °C), the unit will stop in order to avoid further cooling of the dwelling. This may, for instance, be because the heating system in the dwelling has stopped. Heat the dwelling and reset the alarm.

name: Emergency stop
panel: The yellow diode emits light; Green D3 + D4 are flashing
